faq_desc: Quick answers to what you usually wonder about.
faq1_q: Is extra baggage included on VFR flights?
faq1_a: Yes. On most routes to Bangladesh, India, Sri Lanka and Pakistan we work with airlines such as Qatar Airways, Emirates and Biman that allow up to 46 kg (2×23 kg) checked baggage. This is clearly stated on your confirmation.
faq2_a: Once we confirm your seats you receive a written booking confirmation with payment instructions. We accept bank transfer and Swish. When payment is registered we issue your e-ticket.
faq3_q: Do you help with Umrah visas?
faq3_a: Yes. We arrange official Umrah visas to Saudi Arabia and can also assist with entry registrations for Bangladesh, Pakistan, India and Vietnam.
